name: Ayan Ain
bio: A seasoned professional with 22 years of experience in the nutraceutical and pharmaceutical industry, Ayan Ain is currently spearheading the Training and Marketing efforts for Asia at FusionFitNet, a rapidly growing organization that specializes in premium nutrition products from Germany. Throughout his illustrious career, Ayan has had the opportunity to work with renowned companies such as Inovax (in collaboration with Phyjer), Biochem (a leader in antibiotics), British Biological (a prominent player in protein products), Veeba (a top FMCG brand), and VMPL (a trailblazer in India's MLM sector). His expertise in marketing, training, and business development has been instrumental in driving growth and success in the healthcare industry. Ayan's extensive experience has equipped him with a deep understanding of the industry's nuances, allowing him to develop and implement effective strategies that drive results. At FusionFitNet, he is focused on expanding the company's presence in Asia, leveraging his vast network and knowledge to promote the organization's cutting-edge nutrition products. With his passion for delivering excellence, Ayan continues to lead FusionFitNet's growth trajectory, empowering individuals to achieve their health and wellness goals through innovative nutrition solutions.
experience: 22 years in nutraceutical and pharmaceutical industry

name: Piryanka Das
bio: A results-driven professional with 8 years of experience in the nutrition and pharmaceutical industry, Piryanka Das is currently leading the Regional Business efforts for India South and East at FusionFitNet, driving growth and expansion in the region. With a proven track record of success, Piryanka has held key roles in top companies such as British Biological, Veeba, and VMPL, where she honed her skills in business development, training management, and team leadership. Her exceptional abilities in identifying market opportunities and implementing effective strategies have consistently delivered impressive results. As a seasoned professional, Piryanka brings a unique blend of industry expertise, market insights, and leadership acumen to FusionFitNet. She is passionate about empowering individuals to achieve their health and wellness goals through the company's innovative nutrition products. Under her guidance, Piryanka aims to strengthen FusionFitNet's presence in South and East India, fostering partnerships, driving business growth, and delivering exceptional results.
experience: 8 years in nutrition and pharmaceutical industry
